question: Give me a map of airport density using hexagons covering the world. For each hexagon, show its geometry as GeoJSON and the number of airports inside, ordered from most to least, but only include hexagons that contain at least one airport.
sql:
WITH grid AS (
  SELECT geom FROM ST_HexagonGrid((SELECT ST_Extent_Agg(geometry) FROM airports), 5.0)
)
SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(grid.geom) AS hexagon_geojson, COUNT(a.name) AS airport_count
FROM grid
LEFT JOIN airports a ON ST_Contains(grid.geom, a.geometry)
GROUP BY grid.geom
HAVING COUNT(a.name) > 0
ORDER BY airport_count DESC;

question: List the square grid cells (size 10 degrees) that contain at least three airports. For each such cell, return its center point as GeoJSON and the number of airports, sorted by count descending.
sql:
WITH grid AS (
  SELECT geom, i, j FROM ST_SquareGrid((SELECT ST_Extent_Agg(geometry) FROM airports), 10.0)
),
cell_counts AS (
  SELECT grid.geom, grid.i, grid.j, COUNT(a.name) AS airport_count
  FROM grid
  JOIN airports a ON ST_Contains(grid.geom, a.geometry)
  GROUP BY grid.geom, grid.i, grid.j
)
SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Centroid(geom)) AS cell_center_geojson, airport_count
FROM cell_counts
WHERE airport_count >= 3
ORDER BY airport_count DESC;

question: For each major airport, give me the count of mid-sized airports within 500 km. Show the major airport name, its IATA code, and the count, sorted from highest to lowest, excluding major airports with no nearby mid airports.
sql:
SELECT a.name AS major_airport, a.iata_code AS major_iata, COUNT(b.name) AS nearby_mid_count
FROM airports a
JOIN airports b ON a.iata_code != b.iata_code 
  AND a.type = 'major' 
  AND b.type = 'mid'
  AND ST_DWithin_Spheroid(a.geometry, b.geometry, 500000)
GROUP BY a.name, a.iata_code
HAVING COUNT(b.name) > 0
ORDER BY nearby_mid_count DESC;

question: Sum the scalerank values of airports inside each hexagon (size 5 degrees) and return the hexagon geometry as GeoJSON along with the total scalerank. Only include hexagons with a total scalerank of at least 10, sorted by total descending.
sql:
WITH grid AS (
  SELECT geom FROM ST_HexagonGrid((SELECT ST_Extent_Agg(geometry) FROM airports), 5.0)
)
SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(grid.geom) AS hexagon_geojson, SUM(a.scalerank) AS total_scalerank
FROM grid
JOIN airports a ON ST_Contains(grid.geom, a.geometry)
GROUP BY grid.geom
HAVING SUM(a.scalerank) >= 10
ORDER BY total_scalerank DESC;

question: Compare airports by distance from Kansas City Int'l. Group all airports into distance bands (0-500 km, 500-1000 km, 1000-2000 km, beyond 2000 km) and list how many airports fall into each band.
sql:
WITH ref AS (
  SELECT geometry FROM airports WHERE name = 'Kansas City Int''l'
),
distances AS (
  SELECT a.name, ST_Distance_Sphere(ref.geometry, a.geometry) / 1000.0 AS dist_km
  FROM airports a, ref
)
SELECT CASE
    WHEN dist_km <= 500 THEN '0-500 km'
    WHEN dist_km <= 1000 THEN '500-1000 km'
    WHEN dist_km <= 2000 THEN '1000-2000 km'
    ELSE '>2000 km'
  END AS distance_band,
  COUNT(*) AS airport_count
FROM distances
GROUP BY distance_band
ORDER BY distance_band;

question: List every airport with the count of other airports within 100 km of it, showing the airport name, IATA code, and the count. Order by count descending, and include only airports with at least one neighbor within that distance.
sql:
SELECT a.name, a.iata_code, COUNT(b.name) AS nearby_airport_count
FROM airports a
LEFT JOIN airports b ON a.iata_code != b.iata_code
  AND ST_DWithin_Spheroid(a.geometry, b.geometry, 100000)
GROUP BY a.name, a.iata_code
HAVING COUNT(b.name) > 0
ORDER BY nearby_airport_count DESC;
